value.name: physics.Body2D
value.doc: Simulates the node as a rigid body. Colliders on the node and its children form its shape.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: static never moves, kinematic moves by velocity, dynamic reacts to forces and contacts.

fields.name: massMode
fields.doc: auto takes the mass from collider density, override uses Mass.

fields.name: gravityScale
fields.doc: Multiplier of the project gravity for this body.

fields.name: linearDamping
fields.doc: Slows the movement every step, like air resistance; 0 keeps the speed.

fields.name: angularDamping
fields.doc: Slows the rotation every step; 0 keeps spinning.

fields.name: fixedRotation
fields.doc: Keeps the body upright: contacts and torque never rotate it.

fields.name: bullet
fields.doc: Continuous collision against other dynamic bodies, so a fast body cannot pass through them. Costs more.

fields.name: allowSleep
fields.doc: Lets the body sleep after it comes to rest, which saves time; contacts and scripts wake it.

fields.name: interpolate
fields.doc: Draws the body between physics steps for smooth motion; scripts still see the exact pose.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Collision layer, see Project Settings → Physics.

fields.name: velocity
fields.doc: Current velocity in units per second, during Play.

fields.name: angularVelocity
fields.doc: Current rotation speed in radians per second, during Play.

fields.name: awake
fields.doc: Whether the body is simulated this step or sleeping, during Play.

methods.name: ApplyForce
methods.doc: ApplyForce pushes the body's center of mass during the next physics step. Call it from FixedUpdate.

methods.name: ApplyForceAt
methods.doc: ApplyForceAt pushes the body at a world point, which also spins it.

methods.name: ApplyImpulse
methods.doc: ApplyImpulse changes the velocity at once, scaled by mass.

methods.name: ApplyImpulseAt
methods.doc: ApplyImpulseAt applies an impulse at a world point.

methods.name: ApplyTorque
methods.doc: ApplyTorque spins the body during the next physics step.

methods.name: Mass
methods.doc: Mass returns the mass computed from the colliders or the override.

methods.name: MoveTo
methods.doc: MoveTo drives a kinematic body to the pose by the end of the next physics step, pushing dynamic bodies on the way. Call it from FixedUpdate.

methods.name: SetAngularVelocity
methods.doc: SetAngularVelocity sets the spin in radians per second.

methods.name: SetVelocity
methods.doc: SetVelocity sets the linear velocity in units per second.

methods.name: Sleep
methods.doc: Sleep stops the body until something touches it.

methods.name: Teleport
methods.doc: Teleport moves the body to a world pose without sweeping, keeping its velocity.

methods.name: WakeUp
methods.doc: WakeUp makes a sleeping body simulate again.
